# Stock-by-Stock Master Trading Ledger & Causal Price Movement Analysis (5 Years)

**Parameters**: Volume Thrust `VOL >= 1.60x` | Benchmark Headwind `MIDCAP_RET >= -0.50%` | Strict Stop Loss & Trailing Swings  
**Universe**: NIFTY Midcap 150 (1,241 Sessions, Sep 20, 2021 – Sep 18, 2026)  
**Total Executed Trades**: 1,732 trades
